overview_description.description:
Kem was started with the idea of achieving a simple goal, to make it easy to send money to your friends. Millions of people in the Gulf were facing this issue, and we built Kem for the purpose of removing the pain from peer-to-peer payments.

Today, Kem is the fastest growing payments app in Kuwait & the GCC. Pay anyone instantly, receive everywhere, spend anywhere. Join the thousands already using the Kem app.

The Kem App is a financial services platform, not a bank. Banking services are provided by Kem’s bank partner(s). Kem Company for Electronic Payment & Settlement Systems W.L.L is a service of Kem Technologies Holding Ltd.
